question: To whom should the mantra, its form, and all related elements be offered?
premises: The mantra, its form, and related elements are specified.
All of these are to be offered.
The guru is named as the recipient.
inference: One should offer the mantra, its form, and all related elements to the guru.
plain_english: One should offer all that—the mantra, its form, and so forth—to the guru.
